intelligence.enrichment: A digital clinical thermometer should be reset, its tip washed before and after use, placed correctly for body temperature measurement, and read after the beep. Cleaning and correct placement make the thermometer safe to use, and waiting for the beep gives the reading after the thermometer has completed the measurement. The learner correctly applies this rule: A digital clinical thermometer should be reset, its tip washed before and after use, placed correctly for body temperature measurement, and read after the beep. A digital clinical thermometer can be put anywhere on the body and read immediately; cleaning the tip is optional.
